title: docs: add v4.0 schema & toolchain roadmap priorities
body:
Adds prioritized schema infrastructure and cross-ecosystem interoperability roadmap items for v4.0.

- **New section** "v4.0 Schema & Toolchain Roadmap" with P0–P3 priority table:
  - P0: Zod v4 migration (2-7x perf + built-in JSON Schema)
  - P1: JSON Schema output layer for non-TS ecosystems (Python/Go)
  - P2: OpenAPI Spec generation from Zod schemas
  - P3: Effect Schema evaluation as long-term fallback
- **Updated Versioning Plan** v4.0 focus to reflect new priorities alongside existing AI/multi-tenancy items
- **Updated ToC** with new section anchors
